guides.title: How to Set Up Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
guides.titleAr: كيفية إعداد سامسونج جالاكسي S24 الترا
guides.description: Complete step-by-step guide to setting up your new Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra

steps.title: Power On & Language Selection
steps.description: Press and hold the side button for 3 seconds. Select your preferred language and region.
steps.tip: Choose Arabic for a fully localized experience

steps.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
steps.description: Select your Wi-Fi network and enter the password. This is required for downloading updates and signing in.
steps.tip: Use 5GHz Wi-Fi for faster downloads

steps.title: Sign in to Samsung Account
steps.description: Create or sign in to your Samsung account to access Galaxy AI features and Samsung Cloud backup.
steps.tip: Your Samsung account is different from your Google account

steps.title: Sign in to Google Account
steps.description: Enter your Google account to restore apps, contacts, and settings from Google Drive backup.
steps.tip: Enable automatic backup in Google One for seamless transfers

steps.title: Set Up Biometrics
steps.description: Register your fingerprint on the in-display sensor and set up face recognition for secure unlocking.
steps.tip: Add multiple fingerprints for different scenarios

steps.title: Configure S Pen
steps.description: Customize the S Pen button actions and Air Actions in the Advanced Features settings.
steps.tip: Set S Pen click to open the camera for quick shots

guides.title: Transfer Data to Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
guides.titleAr: نقل البيانات إلى سامسونج جالاكسي S24 الترا
guides.description: Migrate all your data from your old phone to the Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra

steps.title: Download Smart Switch
steps.description: Install Samsung Smart Switch on your old device from the App Store or Google Play Store.
steps.tip: Smart Switch supports both Android and iPhone transfers

steps.title: Choose Transfer Method
steps.description: Select between wireless (Wi-Fi Direct) or cable transfer. Cable transfer is faster for large data.
steps.tip: USB-C to USB-C cable provides fastest transfer speeds

steps.title: Select Data to Transfer
steps.description: Choose what to transfer: contacts, messages, photos, apps, settings, and more.
steps.tip: Deselect large video files if you want a faster transfer

steps.title: Start Transfer
steps.description: Confirm on both devices and wait for the transfer to complete. Keep both devices charged.
steps.tip: Keep both phones plugged in to avoid battery issues during long transfers

steps.title: Verify & Finish
steps.description: Check that all data was transferred correctly. Open contacts, photos, and messages to verify.
steps.tip: Some apps may need to be re-downloaded from the Play Store

guides.title: How to Set Up iPhone 15 Pro Max
guides.description: Complete step-by-step guide to activating and setting up your new iPhone 15 Pro Max

steps.title: Power On & Quick Start
steps.description: Press the side button to power on. If you have another iPhone nearby, use Quick Start to transfer settings automatically.
steps.tip: Quick Start is the fastest way to set up a new iPhone

steps.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
steps.description: Select your Wi-Fi network. iOS requires internet connectivity for activation.
steps.tip: Ensure strong signal during activation

steps.title: Sign in to Apple ID
steps.description: Enter your Apple ID and password to access iCloud, App Store, and all Apple services.
steps.tip: Enable two-factor authentication for security

steps.title: Set Up Face ID
steps.description: Follow the on-screen instructions to scan your face from multiple angles for secure authentication.
steps.tip: Set up an alternate appearance for wearing glasses or accessories

steps.title: Configure Action Button
steps.description: Customize the new Action button (top left) to launch your most-used feature: camera, flashlight, shortcut, etc.
steps.tip: Use a Shortcut for complex multi-step actions

steps.title: Restore from iCloud Backup
steps.description: Select your most recent iCloud backup to restore all apps, settings, and data.
steps.tip: Ensure your backup is recent before starting. Apps download in the background.

guides.title: Transfer Data to iPhone 15 Pro Max
guides.titleAr: نقل البيانات إلى آيفون 15 برو ماكس
guides.description: Move all your data from Android or older iPhone to the new iPhone 15 Pro Max

steps.title: From iPhone: Use Quick Start
steps.description: Place your old iPhone next to the new one. Follow the Quick Start prompts to transfer all data wirelessly.
steps.tip: This transfers everything including settings and apps

steps.title: From Android: Download Move to iOS
steps.titleAr: من أندرويد: حمّل Move to iOS
steps.description: Install 'Move to iOS' from Google Play on your Android device before starting iPhone setup.
steps.tip: This app is official from Apple and transfers contacts, photos, messages and more

steps.title: Scan QR Code
steps.description: During iPhone setup, select 'Move Data from Android' and scan the QR code with your Android device.
steps.tip: Disable cellular data on Android for a more stable transfer

steps.title: Select Content
steps.description: Choose which content to transfer: contacts, message history, camera roll, web bookmarks, and more.
steps.tip: WhatsApp messages need a separate transfer process

steps.title: Wait & Complete
steps.description: Keep both phones connected to power and wait for transfer to complete. Tap 'Done' on Android when finished.
steps.tip: Large photo libraries may take 30+ minutes
